notes: Raidar 1.2.1: Player Lookup inventory now shows the 7 most valuable skins with an optional View-all toggle. New /check Discord command and in-game !check team-chat command to look up any player by SteamID. Fixes: travelling vendor marker rotation, RustMaps monument/cave positions on the live map, AFK detection (no longer flags players right after they reconnect), and more accurate vending sales detection.
